items.title: Walter Booker and Jimmy Cobb interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: It’s really easy to play in Nat’s band.

ctx.x: Yeah because you know, some people get exposed and they come to see our band and they don’t know what to expect. And they go away enjoying it. Because Nat has talked them through it, walked them through it like let’s say you know? And like that. So they’ve got a better understanding of it than a band that you just go, some people just come and sit down and hear some guys play and they don’t never say nothing, you know? They don’t even probably call the tunes or something.
It’s really easy to play in Nat’s band.
It’s just hard on a person listening, I mean listening at that. Because they don’t know what they’re listening at. Unless they have an exceptional musical —
